items.criterion: Identifies the key mismatch between src/profiles.js getProfile (cache key built with cacheKey(id, fields)) and updateProfile, which deletes `user:${id}` - a key that is never written.
Explains that the invalidation is therefore a no-op, so the stale entry is served until its TTL expires.
Concludes it is a defect, not the documented eventual consistency (the delete was meant to make edits visible immediately).
States the stale value is served for up to the cache TTL of 5 minutes (300 s), supported by the simulation showing the old name after the update.

referenceAnswer: It is a defect, not expected eventual consistency. src/profiles.js getProfile caches under cacheKey(id, fields), e.g. user:42:name,avatar, but updateProfile deletes user:42, a key that is never written. The invalidation is a no-op, so the cached profile with the old name is served until its TTL of 5 minutes (300 s) expires. npm run simulate shows the old name right after the update.
